_comment: The position immediately AFTER the Garden reveal (#48) -- near_garden's qualifying sleep has already happened (both K-of-4 legs banked: resolved_wrong_order AND cleaned_the_inn, matching garden_walkthrough's own live-earned crossing), garden_door_unlocked is banked, and the vine door is open. Equipped `relcs_spare_spear` (same as near_garden). times_slept 7 (one more than near_garden -- the qualifying sleep already happened here). TRAP: rng_state is a properly-derived state (.seed=9, captured .state), never hand-typed -- WISave restores .state directly, not .seed. This fixture's own canonical never resolves a fight to completion off this rng_state, so its exact value is cosmetic/inert for outcome purposes.
